correctness.rationale: The exact published facet formulas were independently reconstructed. The 60-facet orbit closes to face vector (32,210,480,270,60). A deterministic verifier checks 270 elementary-collapse pairs one by one, leaving a 2-complex with face vector (32,210,270), and exact GF(2) boundary ranks 31 and 179 give Betti vector (1,0,91). Direct unreduced homology is also recomputed and agrees. No finite sampling is used for the claimed finite object.

evidence: Balagopalan proves the ambient complex is an antipodal 4-sphere and records the two facet orbits, but an ambient sphere theorem does not determine the homology of a proper orbit-generated subcomplex.
The later design discussion analyzes the quotient RP4_16 and associated designs, not the topological homology of the lifted 60-facet subcomplex.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Known stronger facts about the whole sphere, its quotient, polytopality, and symmetry do not imply the homology of a single facet orbit; different invariant subcomplexes of a sphere can have unrelated homology.

value.rationale: The 60 facets are not an arbitrary slice: they are the entire smaller orbit under the full symmetry C2 x S6 singled out by the published construction. Determining that this canonical one-fifth of the ambient sphere already carries 91 independent mod-two two-cycles gives a sharp structural description of how the highly symmetric sphere is assembled from its two facet orbits. The exact collapse to dimension two makes the invariant interpretable rather than a raw table lookup.
